name: Maai
title: Levitical musician at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
summary: Maai was a Levitical musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall after the return from the Babylonian exile. He was among the singers and musicians who played musical instruments during the solemn procession led by Ezra the scribe. His role testifies to the importance of worship and music in the restored Jewish community.

keyEvents.title: Dedication of Jerusalem's wall
keyEvents.description: Maai participated as a musician in the great celebration when the rebuilt walls of Jerusalem were dedicated. He marched in the procession with musical instruments along with other Levites.

keyEvents.title: The Procession with Ezra
keyEvents.description: Maai was part of one of the choirs that processed along the wall, led by Ezra the scribe, and played on David's musical instruments.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of temple service
keyEvents.description: As part of the Levitical music corps, Maai contributed to the restoration of formal worship in Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Praise and Thanksgiving at the Wall
keyEvents.description: Maai and the other musicians praised God with song and instruments as the Jewish people celebrated the completion of the walls, a sign of God's faithfulness.
